transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo recertification next week, and two available training blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. I need to publish the final schedule, so let's work through what we know. Bravo's evaluator is being handled through battalion training after this huddle, so that's not on our plate right now. What I do need settled today is the evaluator for Alpha and how we're assigning the two blocks between Alpha and Bravo. Who has information that can help us fill in the gaps?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I can help with the Alpha evaluator. I checked the training database this morning, and the only currently authorized evaluator for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis. He's available during the Monday 0800-1200 block. The evaluator roster hasn't been attached to the weekly schedule yet, but the authorization is confirmed in the system.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical on the Bravo side. I confirmed the bay booking today: Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning. That means Bravo can only train during the Tuesday 1300-1700 block, after motor pool release. The maintenance calendar hasn't been cross-referenced with the training schedule yet, so this constraint hasn't been factored in.
transcript.speaker: A3
